sql:
SELECT p.PromotionCategory AS PromotionCategory,
       sum(s.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount,
       sum(s.DiscountAmount) / sum(sum(s.DiscountAmount)) OVER () AS ShareOfAllDiscounts,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(s.DiscountAmount) DESC) AS Rank
FROM retail.FactSales AS s
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p ON s.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY TotalDiscountAmount DESC
